properties.title: France tackles dodgy condom problem
properties.summary: French health authorities warned Friday that more than 40,000 noncompliant condoms have been sold online in recent months, urging anyone who used affected products to get tested for sexually transmitted infections. properties.title: Germany plans a €12B missile program to deter Putin
properties.summary: BERLIN — The German government expects it will need almost €12 billion to build a new arsenal of long-range weapons aimed at deterring Russia, according to defense ministry documents seen by POLITICO. The weapons would give German forces the ability to hit targets hundreds or even thousands of kilometers behind the front — potentially including command centers, airfields, missile launchers and supply hubs.
